name: detalhar_vaga
description: Shows one job in detail, including the competencies Aya (the AI interviewer) evaluates and the weight of each — the criteria behind every candidate score. Read-only.

name: listar_candidatos
description: Lists the candidates of a job with their interview score, profile fit and pipeline stage, highest score first. Read-only. Does NOT return phone, e-mail or résumé.

name: detalhar_candidato
description: Full evaluation of one candidate: score per competency, the evidence behind each score, red flags, highlights and the human decision if there is one. Read-only. Does NOT return phone, e-mail or résumé.

name: resumo_do_recrutamento
description: Company-wide recruiting numbers: open jobs, candidates, completed interviews, average score and plan usage. Read-only. Contains no personal data.

name: planos_e_assinatura
description: Shows the company's current plan, this cycle's usage (interviews and open jobs against the limits), the plans available with prices, and the link to subscribe or change plan in the Talpy dashboard. Read-only: it never charges or changes the subscription — payment happens only in the dashboard.

name: criar_vaga
description: Creates a new job opening in the company's Talpy account and generates the interview profile Aya will use (competencies and weights). By default the job is created as a DRAFT (not public); set publish=true to open it right away. Counts against the plan's open-job limit. Requires an API key with the

name: entrevistar_candidato
description: Adds a candidate to a job and immediately invites them to an interview with Aya, the AI recruiter. SIDE EFFECTS: with a phone number it sends a real WhatsApp invite to the candidate; without a phone but with an e-mail it sends a real e-mail with the link to the web interview.
